title: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
author: John le Carré
summary: A quiet, retired intelligence man is quietly called back to find a Soviet mole in the top ranks of the British Secret Service. He works through old files and old colleagues to find which of four senior men has betrayed them.
readIf: you like patient, intricate espionage with a keenly observed cast and a pleasingly tough puzzle.
skipIf: you need quick pacing or clear exposition, because the book is dense with names, jargon and time shifts.

pairings.reason: The shorter, more direct earlier novel that is easier to enter and just as bleak.
A very different, procedural thriller, with a cold professional assassin and the men trying to stop him.
